questions.stem: What happens to the rate of diffusion when temperature increases?

options.text: It stays the same because temperature has no effect on diffusion
It stops completely at high temperatures
It decreases because particles move more slowly
It increases because particles have more kinetic energy and move faster

questions.explanation: Higher temperatures give particles more kinetic energy, causing them to move faster and more randomly. This increases the rate at which particles spread from areas of high to low concentration.
